_doc.zh: 软组织材料表。每个数值要么带出处（sources 里的键、所在表格、测试方法、适用的应变范围），要么标 assumption: true。求解器用的是小应变线性化的 E、ν（稳定 neo-Hookean 能量）：软组织其实是强非线性的，这些模量只在应变不超过约 10–15% 时可信；更大的压入会低估反力。
_doc.en: Soft-tissue material table. Every number either has a source (a key of `sources`, the table, the test method and the strain range) or is marked assumption: true. The solver uses small-strain E and ν (stable neo-Hookean energy): soft tissue is in fact strongly nonlinear and these moduli are credible up to strains of about 10–15 % only; deeper presses underestimate the reaction.

model.energy: stable neo-Hookean (Smith et al. 2018 form without the log term): Ψ = μ/2·(I_C − 3) + λ′/2·(J − γ)², linearised to E, ν

viscoelasticity.en: None: velocity damping only. The Prony relaxation parameters of forearm2026 Table 4 (skin g = {0.30, 0.35}, τ = {0.37, 5.59} s; fat g1 = 0.39, τ1 = 700 s; muscle g = {0.89, 0.05, 0.03}, τ = {0.362, 2.54, 52.0} s) are not used.

note.zh: 相对速度的指数衰减率；没有出处，按“抖动在约半秒内消失”取的。
note.en: Exponential decay rate of the relative velocity; unsourced, chosen so that a jiggle dies out in about half a second.

name.zh: 皮肤（混入边界四面体，不单独成层）
name.en: skin (blended into boundary tetrahedra, not a layer of its own)

young.where: Table 4, Skin: M-R + P(2), C10 = 9.4 kPa, C11 = 82 kPa
young.derivation: small-strain shear modulus μ = 2·C10 = 18.8 kPa, E = 3μ = 56.4 kPa

method.zh: 该文按前臂压入曲线筛选文献参数；这一组在以皮肤为主的 P1 点拟合最好（R² = 0.972）。
method.en: That paper screens literature parameters against forearm indentation curves; this set fitted best at the skin-dominant site P1 (R² = 0.972).

young.alternatives: same table: neo-Hookean C10 = 120 kPa (E = 720 kPa); Ogden μ1 = 56.8 kPa, α1 = 13.3

strainRange.zh: 只在小应变下成立：皮肤拉伸几个百分点之后急剧变硬（表中 C11、Ogden 的 α 即为此），本模型没有这一段。
strainRange.en: Small strain only: skin stiffens sharply after a few per cent of stretch (that is what C11 and the Ogden α in the table express); this model has no such branch.

assumptionNote.zh: 全身都用前臂掌侧这一个厚度，是假设。
assumptionNote.en: Using this one volar-forearm thickness for the whole body is an assumption.

note.zh: 文献用 0.495（breastFem2025 的参数表）；这里取 0.49，线性四面体在更接近 0.5 时体积锁死。
note.en: The literature uses 0.495 (parameter table of breastFem2025); 0.49 is used here because linear tetrahedra lock volumetrically closer to 0.5.

note.zh: 密度取教科书量级的数值，没有打开出处。
note.en: Density is a textbook-order value; no source was opened.

young.where: Table 4, Fat: N-H + P(1), μ = 0.53 kPa, g1 = 0.39, τ1 = 700 s

strainRange.zh: neo-Hookean 的小应变模量；脂肪在大压缩下变硬，这里没有。松弛项（g1、τ1）没有用。
strainRange.en: The small-strain modulus of a neo-Hookean fit; fat stiffens under large compression, which is absent here. The relaxation term (g1, τ1) is not used.

name.zh: 骨骼肌（放松；激活时变硬并沿纤维缩短）
name.en: skeletal muscle (relaxed; stiffens and shortens along the fibre when active)

young.where: Table 4, Muscle: Po(2) + P(3), C10 = 0.6 kPa, C01 = 0.55 kPa
young.derivation: μ = 2·(C10 + C01) = 2.3 kPa, E = 3μ = 6.9 kPa (transverse, quasi-static compression)

method.zh: 该文在肌肉为主的点上这一组拟合最好。
method.en: The best-fitting muscle set at the muscle-dominant sites of that paper.

note.zh: 沿纤维的剪切模量（放松，9.5–12.8 kPa）来自 vastus2014；把它换算成沿纤维多出的拉伸模量是本项目的假设。
note.en: The shear modulus along the fibres (relaxed, 9.5–12.8 kPa) is from vastus2014; turning it into an extra tensile modulus along the fibre is this project's assumption.

note.zh: vastus2014：最大随意收缩时沿纤维剪切模量的组均值 482.5±189.6 与 877.5±566.7 kPa，放松时 9.5–12.8 kPa。假设横向模量按同样的倍数变硬。
note.en: vastus2014: group means of the along-fibre shear modulus at maximal voluntary contraction 482.5±189.6 and 877.5±566.7 kPa, relaxed 9.5–12.8 kPa. The transverse modulus is assumed to stiffen by the same factor.

note.zh: 完全激活时静止长度沿纤维缩短 30%，是假设。
note.en: A 30 % shortening of the rest length along the fibre at full activation is an assumption.

forearm2026.citation: Development and Surface Indentation Assessment of an MRI-Based Subject-Specific Hand–Forearm Finite Element Model: A Preliminary Study. Bioengineering (Basel) 2026.
forearm2026.opened: full text (Europe PMC XML): abstract, section 2.3–2.5, Table 4 and the notes of Tables 7–9

note.zh: 单个健康成年男性受试者；作者自称初步研究。表 4 的本构参数是该文从别的文献里取的候选值，那些原始文献本项目没有打开。
note.en: One healthy adult male volunteer; called a preliminary study by its authors. The constitutive parameters of its Table 4 are candidates taken from other papers, which this project did not open.

note.zh: 14 组临床影像（9 组俯卧 MRI–仰卧 CT、1 组 CT、4 组 MRI）；刚性对齐后的标志点距离即俯卧到仰卧的组织位移量级。受试者是乳腺癌患者，乳房体积没有在打开的段落里给出。
note.en: Fourteen clinical image pairs (nine prone MRI–supine CT, one CT, four MRI); the landmark distance after rigid alignment is the scale of tissue motion from prone to supine. The subjects are breast cancer patients; breast volume is not given in the passages opened.

vastus2014.citation: Shear Modulus Estimation on Vastus Intermedius of Elderly and Young Females over the Entire Range of Isometric Contraction. PLoS One 2014.
vastus2014.opened: full text: results and discussion paragraphs with the shear moduli

note.zh: 振动超声剪切波法，沿肌纤维方向的剪切模量；该文正文两处对老年组和青年组的放松值写法相反（9.5±3.3 与 12.8±5.4 kPa），这里只取范围。
note.en: Vibro-ultrasound shear waves, shear modulus along the fibres; the paper's text assigns the two relaxed values (9.5±3.3 and 12.8±5.4 kPa) to the elderly and the young group inconsistently in two places, so only the range is used here.
